pages.lines:
CURRENT RATES
Nightly Rates
RV- $80
Big Rig- $80
Pull Thru- $95
Waterfront-$105
(Rates subject to change. Call us at (410) 639-7485 for current rates.)
Currently we do NOT have any open seasonal sites. If you are interested in being on our waiting list, please complete an application and submit with your deposit for consideration. We recommend coming to visit the park to make sure this is a campground that fits your needs.
To be considered for a seasonal spot, a deposit of $500, with an approved application is required. If you choose to pay a deposit, the money will go towards your lot rent for a future season site. Please keep in mind the deposit is non-refundable and does not guarantee a site for the next season. If a deposit is paid and no site becomes available for the next year, it can then be put towards the following season. Available sites will depend on the number of current seasonal campers that release their site for the next year. The number of open sites is beyond our control.
The waiting list for waterfront sites is a separate list and requires an additional $200, totaling $700 to be on the waterfront waiting list.

pages.lines:
RV REQUIREMENTS
Requirements of each space are that the RV must be not be older than 10 years. If the RV is over 10 years old, it can be submitted for review and approved by the owners. All RVs must have current registration and licensing. A $75 electrical deposit is required for each site, with the fee being refunded on your last electrical bill upon departure. If bringing your furry friends along with you, we require them to be spayed or neutered. Please contact us for more information.
